boundaries: This policy does not implement capture; J24-A/B/C/D must enforce each selector, action and integrity label.
No ordinary snapshot expands counterpart content, consent, media bytes or private moderation/guardian context.
All legacy attribution remains unverified; exclude ambiguous/conflicting actor bindings and report coverage gaps.
Current account/profile proofs establish current selection authority, not historical authorship.

Authored content and media metadata require bounded typed serialization: never emit backend storage paths, tokenized capabilities, raw HTML media URLs without settled asset disposition, or recursively expanded counterpart content.
